thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-09-02 is again thin and single-name/crypto driven (FTC-Amazon ad-surcharge suit, Cathie Wood crypto picks, Bill Gates automation commentary, Ethereum price target, Venezuela oil-deal skepticism, routine politician PTR filings) with no dated, broad-market catalyst suitable for a conservative core-ETF sleeve. Existing VTI position (~22.5 of ~107.5 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than forcing a trade on thin evidence, consistent with capital preservation.
